semiconductor_relevance: High — MEC Taiwan Company Ltd. specializes in materials that enhance adhesion in semiconductor packaging, which is critical for back-end processing.
summary: MEC Taiwan Company Ltd. is a leader in developing specialty chemicals that improve the adhesion between copper and resin in semiconductor packaging substrates. Their innovative technologies support advancements in semiconductor back-end processing, making them a valuable partner for companies in the industry.

regional_presence.Taiwan: MEC Taiwan Company Ltd. is based in Taiwan, focusing on the semiconductor materials market.
